# Incident report: inc_0ef2eb50d16146af93e9ad8cfc2307a6

Every figure below is computed from recorded events.

| Measure | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Time to restore | 0.3 s |

| Failed checkouts | 3 |
| Value of failed carts | 3600 cents across 3 of 3 carts with a recorded total |

## Findings

### A: Code Investigator

Checkouts fail with a 500 server error when customers do not provide a discount code because the code tries to read properties from a missing discount object.

- Confidence: 100%
- Suspect: code 0b0673f7378bb3bad237329bf46e6b4c3ab22b62

diff: services/shoplite/src/shop.js:24

```diff
-    const code = request.body?.discount?.code;
+    const code = request.body.discount.code.trim().toUpperCase();
```

### B: Runtime Investigator

Checkout fails due to a JavaScript TypeError attempting to read property 'code' of an undefined object in shop.js line 24. Configuration did not change.

- Confidence: 60%
- Suspect: code services/shoplite/src/shop.js:24:40

log: container_logs

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'code')
    at file:///data/lab/0b0673f7378b/services/shoplite/src/shop.js:24:40
```

config: config_diff

```
{"config_changed": false, "files_compared": ["services/shoplite/package-lock.json", "services/shoplite/package.json"], "changes": []}
```

## Decision

**code_fix**: Code investigator identified that a recent code change removed optional chaining on discount code requests. Runtime investigator confirmed this introduced a TypeError when customers omit discount codes, while verifying configurations remained unchanged.
